release_notes:
### Added
- **Multi-Device Simultaneous Bluetooth Connections (Up to 3 Active BLE Hosts)**:
  - Supports up to 3 concurrent active Bluetooth host connections (e.g. Work PC, Personal Mac, iPad) alongside wired USB.
  - Multi-target routing architecture: Target 0 (USB Wired), Target 1 (Bluetooth #1), Target 2 (Bluetooth #2), Target 3 (Bluetooth #3), each with individual toggle control, custom profile labels, intervals, movement modes, and schedules.
  - Slot-targeted BLE HID notifications allowing independent jiggling, keystrokes, and profiles across connected hosts.
  - **Per-Slot Advertised Bluetooth Names**: Each Bluetooth slot can advertise its own unique stealth peripheral name with a quick suggestion dropdown (Logitech Wireless Combo, Apple Magic Keyboard, Dell Universal Receiver, etc.) and a Custom name field.
  - **Menu-Targeted Pairing Mode**: Clicking "Start Pairing Mode" on any Bluetooth tab pairs specifically the viewed slot (Slot #1, #2, or #3) with its assigned advertised identity, eliminating round-robin sequencing.
- **General Page Live Target Dashboard**:
  - Live 4-target dashboard card grid displaying real-time connection status (`Wired`, `Power only`, `Connected`, `Waiting`, `Disabled`), active countdown timers ticking to the next jiggle, animated pulse jiggle indicators (`⚡ Jiggling Now!`), and one-click individual/bulk jiggle triggers.
- **Network Page Overhaul & Diagnostics**:
  - Moved Device Hostname & mDNS settings (`http://<name>.local`) to the dedicated Network page.
  - Full real-time network status panel displaying connected SSID, signal strength (RSSI dBm), IP Address, Subnet Mask, Gateway IP, DNS Server, MAC Address, and Wi-Fi Channel.
  - Integrated 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi scanner with available network list, signal strength, security badges, and inline connection setup panel.
  - Toggle switch for Wireless Setup Access Point (SoftAP) enabling or disabling the fallback recovery Wi-Fi network on demand.
- **Dynamic Keyboard Target Routing**:
  - Dynamically populates the keystroke destination dropdown with all active, enabled targets configured on the Jiggler page.
  - Removed redundant top "Save Settings" button from Keyboard and Device tabs.
- **LilyGO T-Dongle-S3 Display Dashboard Enhancements**:
  - Page 0 (Target Status): Displays live link count `BLE: [xC]`, active target countdowns, and dynamic animated waveforms.
  - Page 2 (Bluetooth Status): Displays connected link metrics `x/3 CONNECTED` or pairing countdown `[PAIR#X] Ys...`.
- **Full Backward Compatibility for ESP32-S2**:
  - Single-target mode maintained on ESP32-S2 devices without BLE or display overhead.

### Fixed
- **Stuck Mouse Click / Button State Bug**:
  - Initialized `_buttons` in `BleComboMouse` constructor to prevent attached host mice from being blocked by a persistent phantom left-click state.
- **Bluetooth Advertised Name Decoupling**:
  - Decoupled Bluetooth advertised name from mDNS network hostname, defaulting to stealth combo peripheral identities (e.g., `"Logitech Wireless Combo"`).

### Fixed
- **LittleFS OTA Flash Stall at 6%**:
  - Unmounted LittleFS filesystem (`LittleFS.end()`) prior to raw flash sector writes in `Update.begin(..., U_SPIFFS)` to avoid SPI controller deadlocks during over-the-air updates.
